description: Re-score DC Hub power markets under what-if changes you set (power price, time to power, queue wait, reserve margin, curtailment) and show how rankings move.

avg_kwh_cents_pct.description: Power price % change, e.g. 30 for +30% or -20 for -20%

market.description: Score ONE market by slug (optional), e.g. abilene — slugs from rank_markets

queue_wait_months_delta.description: Months added/removed from interconnection queue wait

reserve_margin_pct_delta.description: Percentage POINTS added/removed from reserve margin, e.g. -5

time_to_power_months_delta.description: Months added (+) or removed (-) from time-to-power, e.g. 12

top_n.description: Markets to return, ranked by |score delta| (default 10)

name: simulate_scenario
title: Market Scenario Simulator
